caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, elongated bowl or vessel with two symmetrical, rounded handles extending from either side. The main body of the bowl has a wide, curved shape that tapers down to a narrower base sitting on a short, oval pedestal. Both the upper edge and the pedestal base are adorned with patterned detailing. The handles at each end of the vessel are spiral, shell-like forms that curve outward. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset detail showing a close-up view of the handle, highlighting its twisted, rope-like texture. The entire drawing is rendered in shades of gray pencil on an off-white or beige background, with shading used to indicate depth and form. The name "HESTER DUMAY" appears in small text at the lower left corner.
title: Silver Bowl
